#!/bin/bash
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# AMP generic-module installer for a pinned legacy CS:GO build.
#
# Run by AMP from the instance directory as an "Executable" update stage.
# Downloads depots 731 (game content) and 740 (Linux dedicated server binaries)
# at fixed manifest IDs, then merges them into a single build directory.
#
#   $1  manifest ID for depot 731
#   $2  manifest ID for depot 740
#   $3  pre-staged build path ("" = download with SteamCMD)
#   $4  force reinstall            (true/false)
#   $5  keep the depot staging copy (true/false)
#   $6  delete bundled bin/libgcc_s.so.1 (true/false)
#   $7  steam.inf appID override   ("" = leave the build's own value alone)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
set -uo pipefail

MANIFEST_731="${1:-}"
MANIFEST_740="${2:-}"
PRESTAGED="${3:-}"
FORCE="${4:-false}"
KEEP_CACHE="${5:-false}"
STRIP_LIBGCC="${6:-true}"
STEAMINF_APPID="${7:-}"

# This script lives in App.RootDir, so derive every path from its own location
# rather than from the working directory AMP happens to use.
ROOT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"    # App.RootDir  (<instance>/csgo2018)
BUILD_DIR="${ROOT_DIR}/740"                  # App.BaseDirectory
STEAMCMD_DIR="${ROOT_DIR}/steamcmd"
CONTENT_DIR="${STEAMCMD_DIR}/steamapps/content/app_740"
MARKER="${BUILD_DIR}/.amp-build-id"
BUILD_ID="731=${MANIFEST_731} 740=${MANIFEST_740}"

log()  { echo "[csgo2018] $*"; }
fail() { echo "[csgo2018] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

mkdir -p "${BUILD_DIR}" || fail "cannot create ${BUILD_DIR}"

# --- post-install fixups, run on every update -------------------------------
finalise() {
    mkdir -p "${BUILD_DIR}/csgo/cfg"

    for exe in srcds_linux srcds_run; do
        [ -f "${BUILD_DIR}/${exe}" ] && chmod +x "${BUILD_DIR}/${exe}"
    done
    find "${BUILD_DIR}/bin" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.so*' -exec chmod 0644 {} \; 2>/dev/null

    # The libgcc shipped with 2018-era builds conflicts with modern glibc and
    # makes srcds_linux segfault on start. The system copy is used instead.
    if [ "${STRIP_LIBGCC}" = "true" ] && [ -f "${BUILD_DIR}/bin/libgcc_s.so.1" ]; then
        mv -f "${BUILD_DIR}/bin/libgcc_s.so.1" "${BUILD_DIR}/bin/libgcc_s.so.1.disabled"
        log "moved bundled bin/libgcc_s.so.1 aside"
    fi

    # srcds looks for steamclient.so under ~/.steam/sdk32. Prefer the copy that
    # shipped with this build; fall back to the one SteamCMD provides.
    local sdk32="${HOME}/.steam/sdk32"
    mkdir -p "${sdk32}"
    if [ -f "${BUILD_DIR}/bin/steamclient.so" ]; then
        ln -sf "${BUILD_DIR}/bin/steamclient.so" "${sdk32}/steamclient.so"
        log "linked steamclient.so from the 2018 build"
    elif [ -f "${STEAMCMD_DIR}/linux32/steamclient.so" ]; then
        ln -sf "${STEAMCMD_DIR}/linux32/steamclient.so" "${sdk32}/steamclient.so"
        log "linked steamclient.so from SteamCMD"
    else
        log "WARNING: no steamclient.so found; the server will run insecure"
    fi

    if [ -n "${STEAMINF_APPID}" ] && [ -f "${BUILD_DIR}/csgo/steam.inf" ]; then
        sed -i "s/^\s*appID=.*$/appID=${STEAMINF_APPID}/" "${BUILD_DIR}/csgo/steam.inf"
        log "steam.inf appID set to ${STEAMINF_APPID}"
    fi

    [ -f "${BUILD_DIR}/srcds_linux" ] || fail "srcds_linux is missing from ${BUILD_DIR}"
    echo "${BUILD_ID}" > "${MARKER}"
    log "build ready: ${BUILD_ID}"
}

# --- install from a copy you staged yourself --------------------------------
if [ -n "${PRESTAGED}" ]; then
    [ -d "${PRESTAGED}" ] || fail "pre-staged path ${PRESTAGED} does not exist"
    [ -f "${PRESTAGED}/srcds_linux" ] || fail "${PRESTAGED} has no srcds_linux in it"
    log "copying pre-staged build from ${PRESTAGED}"
    if command -v rsync >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        rsync -a --exclude 'csgo/cfg/server.cfg' "${PRESTAGED}/" "${BUILD_DIR}/" || fail "copy failed"
    else
        cp -a "${PRESTAGED}/." "${BUILD_DIR}/" || fail "copy failed"
    fi
    finalise
    exit 0
fi

# --- nothing to do? ---------------------------------------------------------
if [ "${FORCE}" != "true" ] && [ -f "${MARKER}" ] && [ -f "${BUILD_DIR}/srcds_linux" ] \
   && [ "$(cat "${MARKER}")" = "${BUILD_ID}" ]; then
    log "build ${BUILD_ID} already installed, skipping download"
    finalise
    exit 0
fi

case "${MANIFEST_731}${MANIFEST_740}" in
    *[!0-9]*|'') fail "both manifest IDs must be set and numeric" ;;
esac

# --- SteamCMD ---------------------------------------------------------------
if [ ! -x "${STEAMCMD_DIR}/steamcmd.sh" ]; then
    log "installing SteamCMD into ${STEAMCMD_DIR}"
    mkdir -p "${STEAMCMD_DIR}"
    curl -sSL "https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz" \
        | tar -xzf - -C "${STEAMCMD_DIR}" || fail "SteamCMD download failed"
    chmod +x "${STEAMCMD_DIR}/steamcmd.sh"
fi

download_depot() {
    local depot="$1" manifest="$2" attempt=0 out
    while [ "${attempt}" -lt 3 ]; do
        attempt=$((attempt + 1))
        log "downloading depot ${depot} manifest ${manifest} (attempt ${attempt}/3)"
        out=$("${STEAMCMD_DIR}/steamcmd.sh" +@ShutdownOnFailedCommand 0 +@NoPromptForPassword 1 \
              +login anonymous +download_depot 740 "${depot}" "${manifest}" +quit 2>&1)
        echo "${out}" | tail -n 20
        if echo "${out}" | grep -q "Depot download complete"; then
            return 0
        fi
        log "depot ${depot} download did not complete, retrying in 15s"
        sleep 15
    done
    return 1
}

for pair in "731:${MANIFEST_731}" "740:${MANIFEST_740}"; do
    depot="${pair%%:*}"; manifest="${pair##*:}"
    download_depot "${depot}" "${manifest}" || fail "depot ${depot} failed after 3 attempts"
done

DEPOT_731_DIR="${CONTENT_DIR}/depot_731"
DEPOT_740_DIR="${CONTENT_DIR}/depot_740"
[ -d "${DEPOT_731_DIR}" ] || DEPOT_731_DIR="$(find "${STEAMCMD_DIR}" "${HOME}/Steam" -type d -name depot_731 2>/dev/null | head -n1)"
[ -d "${DEPOT_740_DIR}" ] || DEPOT_740_DIR="$(find "${STEAMCMD_DIR}" "${HOME}/Steam" -type d -name depot_740 2>/dev/null | head -n1)"
[ -d "${DEPOT_731_DIR}" ] || fail "cannot find the downloaded depot_731 directory"
[ -d "${DEPOT_740_DIR}" ] || fail "cannot find the downloaded depot_740 directory"

# --- merge the two depots into one build directory --------------------------
# 731 (game content) first, then 740 (server binaries) on top of it.
log "merging depot 731 into ${BUILD_DIR}"
cp -a "${DEPOT_731_DIR}/." "${BUILD_DIR}/" || fail "merge of depot 731 failed"
log "merging depot 740 into ${BUILD_DIR}"
cp -a "${DEPOT_740_DIR}/." "${BUILD_DIR}/" || fail "merge of depot 740 failed"

if [ "${KEEP_CACHE}" != "true" ]; then
    log "removing depot staging copy to reclaim disk space"
    rm -rf "${CONTENT_DIR}"
fi

finalise
